summary_1line: Rama orders Lakshmana to secretly leave Sita near Valmiki’s hermitage, and Lakshmana sorrowfully takes her toward the Ganges while hiding the truth.

image_candidates.scene_text: Lakshmana, eyes downcast with grief, helps the joyful and unsuspecting Sita climb into a richly cushioned chariot outside the palace.
Sita in the chariot on the road to the Ganges, touching her twitching eye and speaking anxiously of ominous signs while Lakshmana listens silently in anguish.
At dawn by a quiet riverside hermitage near the Ganges, Lakshmana stands beside the chariot, burdened with sorrow as the journey toward Sita’s abandonment continues.
